name: Poll
description: A ```poll block for pages and whiteboards: a question and its answers as a list ("- …"). Every signed-in reader has their own vote – one answer, or several with "multiple: yes" – and can change or take it back. Readers only ever see how many people chose each answer, never who. The results appear after voting ("results: always" shows them from the start), "closed: yes" ends the poll and "id: …" keeps the votes when the text changes.

blocks.label: Poll
blocks.example:
question: Where does the family trip go?
- Zoo
- Museum
- Swimming pool
